responsibility: Contains the machine description scheduler model for AMD Bulldozer-family bdver1/bdver2 processors in GCC’s i386 backend. It defines decode attributes, automata, integer/AGU/load/FP units, vector-path reservations, and extensive per-instruction latency/throughput reservations for integer, x87, SSE, and AVX forms, allowing instruction scheduling and cost modeling tuned specifically for the first Bulldozer generation rather than older Athlon or newer bdver3 files.
